Scenario fixture: a11ycore-page-title-patterns

01 — CANTTELL: title "Home" is in the generic-titles set

This is a whole-document, single-page-heuristics check: only one outcome per page. Two other single-page signals (very-short title, template-like title such as "Acme | Home") and the cross-page pattern analysis (requires a crawl.pageTitles probe passed via ctx.inputs.probes, which cannot be expressed as static HTML at all) are covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file instead.
